proof_body:
by
  intro G H _ _ π s hs
  constructor
  · rw [eq_bot_iff]
    rintro x ⟨hk, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
    have : h = 1 := by rw [← hs h]; exact hk
    simp [this]
  · intro g
    refine ⟨g * (s (π g))⁻¹, ?_, s (π g), ⟨_, rfl⟩, by group⟩
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, map_mul, map_inv, hs]; group
target_source: ∀ (G H : Type*) [Group G] [Group H] (π : G →* H) (s : H →* G), (∀ h, π (s h) = h) → π.ker ⊓ s.range = ⊥ ∧ ∀ g : G, ∃ n ∈ π.ker, ∃ t ∈ s.range, g = n * t
